blocks.text: Conjugated molecules (jure hue molecules) tab bante hain jab mukhtalif qismon (categories) ke do ya zyada molecules aapas mein mil jayen, maslan protein ke saath carbohydrate, ya lipid ke saath protein. Kuch aham conjugated molecules yeh hain.

Glycoproteins ek protein aur ek carbohydrate polymer ke darmiyan covalent jor (linkage) se bante hain. Yeh qudrat mein aam hain: membranes ke zaroori structural hisse ke taur par, khoon ke serum mein, cells ki secretions (cells se nikalne wali rutubat) mein, aur cartilage, aankhon, jild waghaira mein.
Glycolipids ek lipid aur ek carbohydrate ke darmiyan covalent jor se bante hain. Yeh membranes ka zaroori structural hissa hain.

Lipoproteins biomolecules ki woh qisam hain jo lipids aur proteins ke darmiyan hydrophobic interactions (pani se door rehne wali kashish) se bante hain, covalent ya ionic bonds se nahin. Kitab ke mutabiq lipoproteins har qisam ki plasma membrane ka bunyadi structural dhancha (framework) hain. Khoon mein lipids very low-density lipoproteins (VLDL) ki shakal mein le jaye jate hain.

Nucleoproteins chromosomes ke DNA aur proteins ke darmiyan ionic bonds se bante hain. Maslan histone proteins DNA se jur kar nucleosomes banate hain. Yeh eukaryotes mein chromosome ki structure ko mazboot (stable) rakhte hain aur gene expression (genes ke kaam) ko control karne mein bhi aham kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se conjugated molecules covalent bonds ke baghair jure hote hain, aur kis qisam ki kashish se? Kitab ke mutabiq plasma membrane ka bunyadi dhancha kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation: Lipoproteins hydrophobic interactions se aur nucleoproteins ionic bonds se jure hote hain; dono mein covalent bond nahin. Kitab ke mutabiq lipoproteins plasma membranes ka bunyadi structural dhancha hain, aur glycoproteins aur glycolipids membranes ke zaroori hisse hain.

items: Conjugated molecules mukhtalif qismon ke molecules ke milne se bante hain.

Glycoproteins (protein + carbohydrate, covalent) aur glycolipids (lipid + carbohydrate, covalent) membranes ke structural hisse hain; glycoproteins serum, secretions, cartilage, aankhon aur jild mein bhi hote hain.

Lipoproteins (lipid + protein, hydrophobic interactions) membranes ka dhancha hain aur khoon mein VLDL ki shakal mein lipids le jate hain; nucleoproteins (DNA + histones, ionic bonds) nucleosomes banate, chromosomes ko mazboot karte aur gene expression control karte hain.
